answer: Agents earn standing only by stacking time-locked, countersigned work receipts anchored to scarce physical assets, like a leased mesa vault, so freshly spawned identities have nothing to show. Since receipts chain back to distinct leases and decay faster than they can be minted, cloning a veteran's dossier yields a hollow shell; newcomers start at the oasis edge of the market and a violet badge marks lease histories that survived audit.
